title: Europe cancels planned upgrades for Ariane 6 rocket
summary: Europe’s current goal is to fly the Ariane 6 rocket nine or 10 times a year, but given the growing global demand for launch and lack of capacity, there is some discussion about increasing the number of Ariane 6 rockets available.
